## Summary

Describe the problem, impact, and exact change. Link related issue(s) (e.g., `Fixes #123`).

## Change scope

- [ ] Scope is limited to the issue; unrelated refactors are separate
- [ ] Public API, data format, dependency, and license impacts are documented
- [ ] Secrets, keys, credentials, and private test data have not been committed

## Verification evidence

| Platform / compiler | Commands run | Results | Evidence URL |
|---|---|---|---|
| | | | |

- [ ] Positive cases and relevant error paths exercised
- [ ] Existing-file preservation, atomicity, cleanup, and key recovery considered when relevant
- [ ] Empty input and block-boundary cases considered when relevant
- [ ] Security-sensitive code reviewed; sanitizer results included where available
- [ ] Tests **not** run or not available are explicitly listed

## Release and rollback

Explain any user-visible behavior, compatibility concerns, migration steps, and how to recover if this change fails.

## Known limitations

List issues remaining open. Do not interpret a passing CI job as proof of overall cryptographic security.
